title: Let’s go whaling: Tricks for monetising mobile game players with free-to-play
summary: A 2016 conference talk by a mobile game CEO on the tricks of free-to-play monetization, including player profiles and how to target high-spending whales.
why: HN mostly cites it critically, as an insider's blunt playbook for psychologically exploiting players in F2P and loot box games.

quote.text: Must see video for anyone interested in the topic, from someone explaining how to do these monetizations tactics
